writers.name: Alice
writers.quote: “Think you can close your eyes and keep your claws to yourself for a second?”

writers.name: AuMieux
writers.quote: “She's holding him close and tight, and she's not letting go. Now that everything is resolved, reality and responsability are catching up, too fast, too soon.”

writers.name: Cyto
writers.quote: "After a few breathless moments, their laughter began to subside and Adrien found himself unable to do anything but look at Marinette. Mirth lit her like a spotlight and he was helpless as any moth had ever been, sucked into her glow."

writers.name: dragon_creates
writers.quote: "The girl he was holding in his arms, her hands glued to his in a desperate sign practically begging not to be alone, was someone that he knew far closer to him than any of his friends.Someone who he knew that already had so much on her hands that just got piled on after everything that was said to him. It can’t be.“I SHOULDN’T BE LADYBUG!”"

writers.name: Fay
writers.quote: "Adrien stared at their entwined hands for a moment, making Marinette feel almost shy; she had to fight the urge to not snatch her hand back. The feeling only got worse when he looked up at her, face lit up with the force of a thousand suns.“I’m glad,” he whispered, a look of pure longing flashing over his face. Marinette’s breath caught, unable to do anything but meet his gaze."

writers.name: Kasienda
writers.quote: "She blocked his path, raising her yo-yo. Nino’s blood ran cold. “You’re going to fight me? Over keeping this secret that’s not even yours?! To protect f###ing Monarch?!” Her face blanched - white as Gabriel’s last suit. “Is that what it means to hold a miraculous now?”"

writers.name: KPG
writers.quote: "She’d worked hard for Adrien’s love. But hardworking hands get roughed up, and swollen hands don’t fit where they’re meant to."

writers.name: Marble Tavern
writers.quote: "But if I deserved the world it would burn under my ruling as I'm a disaster in the making.”“Well, I’d gladly burn in your name, My Lady."

writers.name: Mie/Mieri
writers.quote: "Marinette knows what true love is. She knows when it comes jumping from rooftop to rooftop, landing with ease on her balcony floor. Love, as it always has, comes to her in the form of Chat Noir."

writers.name: Mystic
writers.quote: "The tension between them was like a tightly wound band on the brink of snapping, the impending release promising a cataclysmic explosion of emotion, reminiscent of a supernova."

writers.name: Anastasia
writers.quote: “The cat perched on your window tilts its head in curiosity, canines flashing in a too-wide grin only a feline can manage. "What'cha waiting for?" it asks you.”

writers.name: Ink
writers.quote: "“You know… I wouldn’t mind another proposal,” Chat said, looking up at the sky. It was late evening, and the stars were starting to come out.“Maybe when we’re older,” Ladybug murmured.Chat curled up closer, his head on Ladybug’s lap..“Yeah… when we’re older.”"

writers.name: Kayla
writers.quote: "But that was the year Marinette learned that snow could lie. A beautiful white could blanket the city. It could quiet the bustle of people and cars, even soothe the stutters of her heart. But beneath it all, the same old cracks in the pavement remained."
wont: Ships including Felix, Luka, or Lila

writers.name: Linerle
writers.quote: "“Um,” said Marinette. She held up a heart-shaped card. She was fourteen, and so was the date of February. And she was more in love than she'd ever been with anyone before, except Clara Nightingale."

writers.name: Meg
writers.quote: "“I can’t leave her out there alone,” Chat Noir says, almost desperate, and somehow the prospect of leaving his partner alone seems to pain him more than his ruined wing. “I promised to protect her.”"

writers.name: Nell
writers.quote: "The moon split in half, eyes as blue as the sky and as cold as an ocean that’s a hundred stories high. “Marinette! Our love did this! Give me your miraculous and we can fix everything!”"

writers.name: Nina
writers.quote: "Felix reaches for the first branch, unafraid."

writers.name: SemantiTheft
writers.quote: "She wouldn’t want his life. All the attention, all the cameras. Never a quiet, private moment. Never a little, quiet place. Not even in his head. He was a mountain of fears and a deep, dark pit of regret. Aimless, practically joyless. A beautiful, expensive house that no one lived in."

writers.name: Trisha
writers.quote: "The rules are only for him. Everyone else can tell their partners. He's not allowed."
